test_title: PYST 24: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the mother of B'

A - B means 'A is the brother of B'

A × B means 'A is the wife of B'

A ÷ B means 'A is the father of B'

Based on the above, how is S related to U if 'Q × R - S ÷ T + U'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

**Given statement :** Q × R - S ÷ T + U

So,

 
• Q × R → Q is the wife of R.
 
• R - S → R is the brother of S.
 
• S ÷ T → S is the father of T.
 
• T + U → T is the mother of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e507c607636288c5ce76d4877056de70bedc045af1216a84393fd48c5c61a34c.png] 

​Thus, according to the given statement, 

S is the maternal grandfather i.e mother's father of U.

Hence, "**Mother's father**" is the correct answer.
